children: Recursion amended its long-term data collaboration with Tempus and separately licensed its TxFM RNA foundation model for oncology. The amendment extends the Master Agreement to a six-year term from its Nov. 3, 2023 start, removes Recursion's convenience termination right, resets Annual License Fees to $14 million on each of the third, fourth and fifth anniversaries (with at least $4 million in cash each year), and reduces the total unique de-identified records accessible. In a parallel move, Tempus will license the TxFM model for two years on a non-exclusive basis for $12 million, paid in two installments, and will provide de-identified pathology records with linked clinical data. Together, the moves refine economics of the data partnership while monetizing Recursion's RNA model in oncology.
